messages:
marina-cs: Customer reports intermittent 403s for text generation when running their nightly batch importer. UI tests work (chat + embeddings), but the batch job gets 403 on /v1/generate. They repro reliably from their job runner but not from local curl.

marina-cs: Error payload they see: `HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden` and body: `{
  "error": { "type": "insufficient_scope", "message": "missing scope: generation" }
}`

marina-cs: Provided sample curl that fails from their runner: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_ABC..." -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"redwood-1.0","input":"hello"}'```

marina-cs: They say same key works in our playground and when they run curl from laptop. Only fails from their job container (k8s) and only when the job payload is large (many parallel requests).

oliver-sre: @marina-cs tagging infra for potential proxy/header truncation. Quick question: can they paste the raw Authorization header length from failing vs working env? Also any intermediate proxy or envoy?

marina-cs: They confirmed: their failing job sends `Authorization: Bearer sk_live_ABC...` and an additional custom header `X-Job-Meta` that can be ~2.5k chars for huge batches. Working curl has tiny metadata header.

oliver-sre: That rings alarm bells. We've seen cases where large headers get truncated by an ingress proxy which can cut off the tail of the bearer token (or trailing scope claim if token is long). If token string is intact but the auth service parses a comma-separated scope list in an adjacent header that gets clipped, it can drop the `generation` entry.

dana-eng: Can we reproduce locally by sending a long header with the same job meta size? If yes, we can confirm header truncation path. Also check our edge logs for truncated-header warnings.

marina-cs: Repro steps they gave: run inside a container: ```for i in $(seq 1 1000); do curl -s -D - -o /dev/null -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_ABC..." -H "X-Job-Meta: $(head -c 2500 /dev/urandom | base64)" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate; done``` They say ~1/4 of requests return 403 with missing generation scope.

oliver-sre: Thanks. I ran a quick local repro with envoy proxy and saw its `buffered_headers_bytes` limit drop tail content when combined headers exceed 8k. The bearer token survived but a long custom header clipped trailing characters in `X-Scopes` (we have customers passing scopes in a header for legacy integrations). If their provisioning pipeline attaches scopes via header instead of encoded claims, truncation can remove the word `generation`.

marina-cs: Customer confirmed they do set a header `X-Scopes: embeddings rerank generation` from an older library (we should recommend bearer-encoded scopes).

oliver-sre: Actionable items: 1) Ask customer to stop sending scopes via custom header and instead use a key with encoded scopes (recommended). 2) Short-term workaround: reduce X-Job-Meta size below threshold. 3) We'll add a check in our edge to reject requests with header length near truncation with a clearer 400 and log reason.

dana-eng: I'll open a runtime ticket to add explicit detection and a log entry when header parsing sees an unexpected cutoff token (PRD: edge-proxy: detect-truncated-scope). Also adding a note in docs about header size and scope-headers being fragile.

kevin-pm: Customer impact: nightly job failing intermittently causes missed imports. Proposed mitigation: we can temporarily add a proxy-side repair that, when Authorization token present and X-Scopes header appears truncated, attempt to fetch scopes via the token introspection endpoint before returning 403. Is that safe?

oliver-sre: Token introspection could be used but added latency for every request is problematic at scale. For now we can provide it as a short-lived mitigation for this org only (feature-flag on the route). Need approval from security for extra introspection.

marina-cs: Customer asked for suggested messaging. Drafted response: "We found the issue: very large custom headers in your batch runner occasionally exceed an internal proxy limit and truncate an adjacent header that lists allowed scopes. When the `generation` scope is lost, requests to /v1/generate return 403. Immediate fixes: shorten the X-Job-Meta header or stop passing scopes via headers and instead use an API key/SSO token with the right scopes. We're working on a safe mitigation on our edge and will follow up with a permanent fix."

dana-eng: Noted. I'll create the internal ticket ics-4321 and include repro steps + sample env to validate.

oliver-sre: For the support thread: resolution plan and owner: 
- Short-term: support hold with customer, recommend header size reduction (marina-cs)
- Medium-term: runtime change to detect truncated headers and return explicit 400 + log (dana-eng, ETA 3 days)
- Optional mitigation: per-tenant introspection flag for route (security review, owner: oliver-sre)
- Long-term: doc + deprecate scope headers (dana-eng)

infra-bot: Incident note created: I-2391234567 - "Header truncation causes loss of scope header -> intermittent 403s for generation" assigned to dana-eng.

marina-cs: Customer ok with mitigation path. Closing loop: they will try reducing job-meta size and report back. Follow-ups: please comment here when medium-term runtime change is deployed so I can confirm with them. :thumbsup:
